newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco/AMP jt venture moves ahead exploration.
newsitem.headline: Codelco/AMP jt venture moves ahead exploration.

text.p: Minera Los Andes, a joint venture between Chile state copper company Codelco and Australian fund manager AMP, will start drilling next year at two sites in northern Chile, said the firm's general manager.
"We could be drilling at Sierra Morena and Exploradora by January or February," Nicolas Saric, general manager of Minera Los Andes, told Reuters.
The sites are among four given by Codelco to the company which was set up this year.
Codelco already carried out exploration work on Exploradora which is known to show signs of copper mineralization, he said.
Minera Los Andes expects to spend $6-8 million in exploration next year with plans including prospecting on the firm's other two properties, Sierra Jardin and Maria Delia.
Codelco controls 65 percent of Minera Los Andes with the rest held by the Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP).
